reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I also saved her note in the brain as unverified: someone at Thornbury Cloth Co. said on a call that the signed order form is due 23 May.

I couldn't confirm the date. There are no Thornbury account files I can see, and nothing else in the brain mentions an order-form deadline. Two things don't add up: no year was given, and if it means this year, 23 May has already passed.

I suggested she check the date with the Thornbury contact or the account owner before anyone relies on it. If she gets a confirmed date, I'll update the note.
